exposure: external cephalic version (ECV) for breech presentation at term
spontaneous vaginal deliveries after successful version
Women with spontaneous vaginal deliveries after successful ECV
outcome: Tolerance of side effects of ECV
cohort: 131 women with breech presentation at term
finding: While ECV was not associated with greater satisfaction with childbirth overall, women with successful ECVs were more likely to undergo the procedure again and recommend it to others, and only those who had subsequent spontaneous vaginal deliveries were more satisfied than those with planned cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Women with successful ECVs followed by spontaneous vaginal deliveries were more satisfied with childbirth than those with planned cesarean sections.
